name: quota-orchestrator
description: Selective multi-model routing with automatic global profile reconciliation and a PreToolUse delegation guard after hook trust.

interface.shortDescription: Selective multi-model routing for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: One plugin for Codex and Claude Code. Codex configures nine global routing profiles and checks delegations with trusted hooks. Claude Code supplies five specialized agents, the quota-orchestrator skill, and identity hooks. Custom settings are preserved; start a new task to load changes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check whether the QuotaOrchestrator SessionStart hook has reconciled my global routing profiles, and help resolve any warnings.
